in_sanskrit.name: Falaagam
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of Sacrifice
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Falaagam एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Falaagam is a Sanskrit name derived from the Hindu deity Indra. It means 'Lord of Sacrifice'. In Hindu mythology, Indra, the god of rain, is known to be a fierce warrior and a patron of warriors. Falaagam signifies the strength, courage, and sacrifice that a warrior embodies.
